v1.passage: On Saturday, Mei went to the community garden with her neighbor Sam. They wanted to learn how to grow beans in a small wooden box. Sam brought seeds, and Mei carried water from the tap near the gate. An older volunteer showed them how deep each seed should go. They worked slowly so that the rows stayed straight. Before leaving, they agreed to share the job of watering during the week. Mei wrote their names on a small card beside the box. On the way home, she wondered which seed would produce the first green shoot.

v2.passage: On Saturday, Mei met Sam at the community garden. A volunteer had set aside a wooden box for their beans and asked them to learn the planting method before they began. Sam brought seeds while Mei filled a small can at the tap. Following the demonstration, they placed each seed at the same depth and covered the row gently. They decided to share the watering work: Mei would come on weekdays, and Sam would visit at the weekend. Mei wrote this arrangement on a card beside the box. As they left, a light rain began to fall over the fresh soil.

v3.passage: On Saturday, Mei and Sam arrived at the community garden to plant beans. They stopped beside a volunteer who offered to help them learn a simple planting method. After watching her demonstration, Sam placed the seeds in a wooden box while Mei covered them with soil. The tap was nearby, so they did not have to carry water far. They would share the watering work over the coming weeks, with Mei visiting on weekdays and Sam taking the weekend. Before leaving, they checked that the card beside the box showed both names. Neither knew when the first shoot would appear.
